description.value: Terra Firma Farms is a certified-organic operation on Highway 23 just outside Revelstoke, BC, selling seasonal vegetables, herbs, and seedlings through an unstaffed, self-serve farm stand operating on the honour system. The farm emphasises soil health through crop rotation, cover crops, and natural minerals, and its produce also supplies Terra Firma's Kitchen, a farm-to-table restaurant in downtown Revelstoke. Selection is richest through summer and fall, with more modest availability in winter and spring.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at terrafirmafarms.ca confirms an active organic farm stand at 1315 HWY 23, Revelstoke, BC, operating on a self-serve honour system — corroborating the OSM shop=farm tag. The site lists fresh vegetables, herbs, tomatoes, peppers, and seedlings, confirming basic groceries. No mention anywhere of bike parking, water bottle refill, washrooms, or other cyclist-specific amenities, so those remain null.
concerns: No phone number present in OSM record or on website.
Address absent from OSM; sourced entirely from website: 1315 HWY 23, Revelstoke, BC.
Stand is unstaffed (self-serve honour system), so water bottle refill and any attended services are unverifiable without a site visit.
Terra Firma's Kitchen in downtown Revelstoke may be a separate WWC candidate and should not be conflated with this farm-stand record.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: The farm stand is a legitimate, active source of fresh local produce on a highway cycling corridor near Revelstoke, but neither required criterion (bike parking, water bottle refill) can be confirmed from available evidence. A site visit or direct contact is needed before full accreditation.
enrichment_extras.notes: Seasonal produce availability is explicitly noted as modest in winter and spring months. The farm email terrafirmafarms@gmail.com appears consistently across all website pages and could be used to verify cyclist amenities directly.

Basic groceries.detail: Self-serve stand stocks organic vegetables (broccoli, cauliflower, kale, chard, cabbage, lettuce), a wide variety of tomatoes and peppers, and fresh herbs; availability is seasonal
